a recording powder flowmeter is a valuable tool for the qualitative and quantitative measurement of uniformity of flow, and that a double-rotorary press equipped with induced powder feed is effective in minimizing intertable variations of a nonuniform flowing formulation.

the recording powder flow meter is a useful tool for the qualitative evaluation and quantitation of the uniformity or nonuniformity of powder flow and that the induced die feed mechanism on a double- rotary press can be used to minimize intertablet weight variation for formulations that are nonuniform in flow.
